title: Fried winter root vegetables
ingredients: 1   celeriac, peeled, cut into 1.5 cm cubes
method: Melt the duck fat in a deep frying pan set over a medium heat. Tip in the celeriac cubes and fry until browned.
Add the shredded carrot, cabbage, chopped garlic and thyme, and cook for a further 2 minutes; serve hot.
